---
title: Fried Scamorza
id: MAR-0068
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 340 g scamorza
- 2 eggs
- to taste all-purpose flour (as needed)
- to taste breadcrumbs (as needed)
- to taste frying oil (as needed)
- to taste salt and pepper (as needed)
## Method
1. Slice the scamorza into slices.
2. Crack the eggs into a bowl, salt them, pepper them, and beat them with a fork.
3. Dredge the scamorza slices in the flour, removing the excess.
4. Then dip them in the eggs, drain them, and place them on the breadcrumbs, pressing them lightly with the palm of your hand.
5. Heat plenty of oil and fry the cheese slices in it, a few at a time.
6. Drain them, place them on paper towels, and serve them immediately while still hot.
